spectral_projective_protocol.direct_projective_setting_statement: The four stored observables are pairwise noncommuting, so no single rank-one projective basis directly diagonalizes any pair. Four settings are therefore required by this direct spectral protocol. This is not a minimum over general POVMs, ancillas, or joint reconstruction schemes.

ideal_control_bridge.logical_implication: For each spectral basis change U, diag(det(U)^-1,U) lies in SU(8). The locked full-rank su(8) result therefore makes each target reachable in the frozen isolated model with ideal unbounded piecewise controls. It supplies no duration or pulse.

impulsive_GSB_SE_ESA_type_audit.interpretation: The 72 rows are functionals on a 2401-coordinate process tensor, whereas the new targets are four functionals on a 49-real-coordinate root state. A preparation/evolution/detection contraction is required before a row-span comparison is defined. The older full-rank 16-column theorem concerns only the selected exciton-1/2 process block, while every new observable has substantial support outside that block. This is a typing result, not a universal optical no-go.

scope_warning: This certificate closes the ideal finite-model measurement design, not its apparatus realization. Lie-algebra controllability does not provide bounded pulses, bath robustness, finite-time fidelity, orientational averaging, detector calibration, or a direct GSB/SE/ESA contraction.
